title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Goons attack Cheran and Chandayatha, but passersby rescue them. Meanwhile, Vannathi slips away from the theatre to avoid Pandian, while Chozhan buys gold bangles for Nila.

title: Bigg Boss
description: VJS reviews the luxury task, exposing Mining Mafia's flawed choices and slamming Cowboys' dirty conduct. Tension peaks as video proof confirms the accusations on Akshitha.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Sakthivel invites Pandian's family to Gandhimathi's grand birthday celebration, leaving them surprised. Later, Pandian's family comes together at his home to join the festivities.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Shruthi remains firm in her decision not to have the baby despite being pregnant, while Ravi refuses to accept it. Meanwhile, Muthu confronts Ragu at the car auction but loses.

title: Super Singer Junior
episodeTitle: A Musical Salute to Gaana King Deva
description: The Godfather of Gaana music, Deva sir, is honoured through a musical tribute. Singers celebrate his extraordinary talent and legacy with soulful performances.
